revision.content:
# Design Comparison of Project Alpha and Project Beta

## Storage Mechanisms

Project Alpha uses SQLite for storage. [E1]

Project Beta stores 92 litres. [E2]

Project Alpha has a capacity of 37 litres. [E3]

Project Beta uses append-only log files. [E4]

## Sunday Write Operations

Project Alpha stops writing on Sundays. [E5]

Project Beta permits writes on Sundays. [E6]

## Backup Strategies

Project Alpha performs a backup once per day. [E7]

Project Beta runs backups twice a day. [E8]

## Source and coverage report
